cohort: Deliveries from 2 million individuals in the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database in 2008 and 2018 were analyzed.
finding: Maternal age (>34 years), male physician's sex (in 2008), lower income levels, and non-central regions were associated with higher C/S rates, with some factors showing temporal variation.
